candidate: Use only prior labeled disagreements with the same ordered pair (observer class, alternative class) for that alternative. Compare wins and losses from the stored predictions as issued at the time. For each alternative require at least five decisive outcomes and one-sided exact binomial tail <= 0.05 / number of alternatives. Choose lowest tail, tie by fixed tool order. Otherwise retain the observer. Equal treatment of both classes.
controls: first feedback Macro-F1 frozen for the rest
shared: All arms receive the same issued tool outputs; identical feedback ids and upper bound; no target refitting of tools. Observer and selectors update after each batch. Seed 17 for the primary comparison. Global and once compare the observer, majority and each fixed predictor, with observer first for ties.
development_replay: Official public and UCI late stream, inherited fit, ids, classes and budget of 32 per batch. Primary is pooled Macro-F1, with worst recall per true class.
new_hardware: Zenodo 6821340, Robin et al., fixed file MD5 6ce3fefe1852219e1a66b3fcc24db045. Train only on sensor A author-training mixtures. Test independently on all author-test mixtures on B and C, one observation per distinct mixture, ordered by increasing mixture id, excluding any source-train overlap. One feature per sub-sensor per 12-second temperature block, mean over samples and stable repeats. Target binary high TVOCsens above source-training mixture median; this is a research classification endpoint. Five fixed models from existing Chongqing bank (logistic, RF, CatBoost, shrinkage LDA and RBF SVM). Eight equal-size simulated sequential groups; 8 returned tests per group, selected by hash of seed and mixture id. Reset state on each target sensor. No file name, mixture id or day as predictor. No simulated noise.
accept: For promotion require at least 0.01 pooled Macro-F1 over the observer, global selection, once and best fixed tool on EACH new hardware unit; worst class recall within 0.02 of best fixed and observer. No public score drop greater than 0.01. If it fails, close this rule as a default and return to a whole-system decision.
research_scope: B and C measure the same held-out mixtures at the same time; report paired per-device results, not two independent chemistry trials. The increasing mixture ID and one-batch return lag are a simulated maintenance schedule.
